items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Did you work with Jimmy Noone? Yeah. But I didn't -- I wasn't with him very long at the Dreamland.

ctx.x: That was when I left Erskine Tate. I just came across the street to the Regal.
Well, you've worked and recorded with a lot of the musicians who came from New Orleans, like the Dodds Brothers. You worked with Jimmy Noone, I believe.
